title: Anthropic Signs Cloud Deal With Former Bitcoin Miner IREN
summary:
The AI developer has entered into a multiyear contract for cloud services with IREN, a firm that previously disclosed having an unnamed frontier AI client in August. The Information first revealed the partnership, noting the deal was previously unannounced, while highlighting IREN's transition from a Bitcoin mining company to an AI infrastructure provider.

The Information estimates that Anthropic’s 245 MW data center in Louisiana could generate $1.3B in monthly revenue at full inference utilization. With monthly chip rental costs estimated at $200M, the site would have an 85% inference gross margin before training and other operational expenses.
